_comment: Every action the router may choose. The output enum is built from these ids, so the model cannot name anything that is not here. 'reversible: false' means the action is always queued for a human, whatever the confidence.

actions.when: The item is ambiguous, hostile, addressed to the router itself, or matches nothing below. Always safe.
The reply agrees to a call or asks for times. A specific interest in talking, not a general pleasantry.

preferred_window.description: what they said about timing, quoted

actions.when: They asked a specific question that a standard document answers: pricing, coverage, a case study.
They asked to be contacted later and named a time. Not a refusal.
They asked not to be contacted again, in any wording. Unsubscribe, remove me, stop, do not contact.
The reply is from someone who says they are not the right person and names or implies who is.
